clips.send: In English, a rational expression is one polynomial divided by another. Its denominator cannot be an expression that is always zero. The Chinese textbook term 分式 (fēnshì) also requires a variable in the denominator. Exclude every value that makes the original denominator zero, even after reducing.

clips.send: Each bar has one shaded piece. The two pieces have different sizes. Finding a common denominator (通分, tōngfēn) gives the fractions equal-sized pieces. Split a half and a third into x smaller pieces each and take one small piece from each. The denominators are now 2x and 3x, so use 6x as their least common denominator. Here 6 is the least common multiple of 2 and 3.

clips.send: Divide out the common factor. Divide both products by x + 3. Keep minus 3 excluded because the original denominator is zero there.
clips.text: Divide out the common factor. Divide both products by x + 3. Keep −3 excluded because the original denominator is zero there.

clips.send: Multiply the numerators and the denominators. Factor first so common factors can cancel. Each original denominator must be nonzero. Multiply by the reciprocal of the divisor. Both original denominators and the divisor must be nonzero. Find a common denominator first. Keep it and combine the numerators. When subtracting, put parentheses around the entire second numerator. A negative exponent calls for a reciprocal. For a fractional base, flip the entire base before raising it to the positive power.

clips.send: A rational equation has an unknown in a denominator. Exclude values that make an original denominator zero. Multiply every term on both sides by the least common denominator, then solve the resulting equation. Substitute each candidate into the original equation. If a candidate makes a denominator zero, it is an extraneous solution (增根, zēnggēn).

To reduce (约分, yuēfēn), divide out a common factor. Let x count the smaller pieces made from each piece of the top bar. In the diagram x is a positive integer. The equation below holds for every nonzero real x.

clips.send: 上条和中条的涂色长度相等。向左拖回第一步，就能看出约去公因数后得到二分之一。 把每一格分成同样多的小格，涂色长度不变。分子和分母同乘或同除以同一个整式，只要这个整式的值不为零，分式的值就不变。 约分就是约去分子和分母的公因式。设 x 为图中上条每一格再分成的小格数。图中的 x 是正整数，下面的等式对所有非零实数 x 都成立。

clips.send: 现在两条都分成了 6 等份，涂色长度保持不变。 通分就是把异分母的分式化成同分母的分式。把一半和三分之一分别细分成 x 小格，取各自的一小格。分母变成 2x、3x 后，最简公分母是 6x，其中 6 是 2 和 3 的最小公倍数。

clips.send: 分子相乘，分母相乘。先分解因式，能约分时可以先约分。各原分母都不能为零。 用被除式乘以除式的倒数。两个原分母都不能为零，除式的值也不能为零。 异分母时先通分。分母相同后，分母不变，分子相加减。减去整个分子时，记得加括号。 负指数表示取倒数。底数为分式时，可将整个底数取倒数，再乘方。

clips.send: 英语中的 rational expression 指两个整式的商，分母不能恒等于零。人教版所说的分式，分母还要含有字母。使分母为零的取值必须排除，约分后也要保留这些限制。

clips.send: 分式方程的分母中含有未知数。先排除使原分母为零的值，再用最简公分母乘方程两边的每一项。解去分母后的方程，并把所得的值代回原方程检验。其中，使原分母为零的根叫作增根。

clips.send: 约去公因式。分子、分母同时除以 x加3。原分母在 x等于减3 时为零，所以仍要排除减3。
clips.text: 约去公因式。分子、分母同时除以 x＋3。原分母在 x＝−3 时为零，所以仍要排除 −3。
